create_dataset_status_endpoint: create a FastAPI endpoint that returns cached responses and pending jobs for each processing step of a dataset
run_dataset_status_endpoint: run the dataset status endpoint to retrieve cache and job information for a specified dataset
test_dataset_status_endpoint: test the dataset status endpoint with a dataset parameter and optional authentication
review_create_dataset_status_endpoint: review the create_dataset_status_endpoint function that builds a FastAPI route for dataset status
summarize_dataset_status_endpoint: summarize the dataset status endpoint that aggregates cache and queue data across all processing steps
